title: Formation of the made field: bound, conserved densities and oscillator cells

key_results.statement: Class F, Ω the nondegenerate lowest eigenvector of $C_F$, first order in $g_s$: $\delta a(x,\lambda)=-\sum_{n\ne0}[\langle\Omega|A_x|n\rangle\langle n|B_0|\Omega\rangle g_\lambda(\omega_n)+\langle\Omega|B_0|n\rangle\langle n|A_x|\Omega\rangle\overline{g_\lambda(\omega_n)}]$ with $g_\lambda(\omega)=(1-e^{-i\omega\lambda})/\omega$; the static mark is the same with $g_\lambda\to1/\omega$.

Label form of (4.1) by translation covariance: $\delta a_{\mathbf q}(\lambda)$ pairs $A_{\mathbf q}$ with $B_{-\mathbf q}$ and carries the factor $1/|X_f|$; $\delta a^{\rm st}_{\mathbf q}$ is the same with $g_\lambda\to1/\omega_n$.

Sum-rule weight $f_A(\mathbf q)=|X_f|^{-1}\langle\Omega|[A_{\mathbf q}^\dagger,[C_F,A_{\mathbf q}]]|\Omega\rangle\ge0$ and static self-response $\chi_Y(\mathbf q)\ge0$, fixed by $C_F$, the operator and Ω; for $B=A$, $\delta a^{\rm st}_{\mathbf q}=-\chi_A(\mathbf q)$.

Item 1, class F, every $\mathbf q$, $L$ and $\lambda\ge0$: $|\delta a_{\mathbf q}(\lambda)|\le\min\{\lambda\sqrt{f_A\chi_B},2\sqrt{\chi_A\chi_B}\}$; for $B=A$, $|\delta a_{\mathbf q}(\lambda)/\delta a^{\rm st}_{\mathbf q}|\le\lambda\sqrt{f_A/\chi_A}$; also for the nondegenerate highest eigenvector with $|f_A|$, $|\chi|$.

If $A$ is the density of a number conserved by every term of $C_F$, with $[A_x,A_y]=0$, then $0\le f_A(\mathbf q)\le c_A|\mathbf q|^2$ for every $L$, with $c_A=4\nu n_A^2R_A^2\max_\gamma\|h_\gamma\|\,\|A_0\|^2$.

Under (4.5), for every source operator $B$: formation of the label component $\mathbf q$ to accuracy $\varepsilon$ needs $\lambda\ge(1-\varepsilon)|\delta a^{\rm st}_{\mathbf q}|/(|\mathbf q|\sqrt{c_A\chi_B(\mathbf q)})$.

Item 2, $B=A$ a conserved density with a long-range mark $|\delta a^{\rm st}_{\mathbf q}|\ge s_0/|\mathbf q|^2$: $\lambda_{\rm form}(\mathbf q;\varepsilon)\ge(1-\varepsilon)\sqrt{s_0/c_A}\,|\mathbf q|^{-2}$, so the long-range part cannot form within a $\lambda$ linear in the distance (also for the highest eigenvector).

Position form, $B=A$, cubic torus, $L\to\infty$ then $\ell\to\infty$, with $\chi_A\le s_1/|\mathbf q|^2$ and $\delta a_{\rm st}=s/|x|+o(|x|^{-1})$: formation at every place of the shell $\ell\le|x|\le2\ell$ needs $\lambda\ge C\ell^2(1+o(1))$ with an explicit $C>0$.

Item 2, $B\ne A$ (several kinds of objects included), under (4.5) with a long-range mark: formation within $\lambda\le\beta/|\mathbf q|$ at long-range labels requires $\chi_B(\mathbf q)\ge(1-\varepsilon)^2s_0^2/(\beta^2c_A|\mathbf q|^4)$; for every $B$ with $\chi_B\le s_B/|\mathbf q|^2$ (the class of the question's note (a)), $\lambda_{\rm form}(\mathbf q;\varepsilon)\ge(1-\varepsilon)s_0/(\sqrt{c_As_B}|\mathbf q|^2)$ for $|\mathbf q|\le q_1$, so the long-range part of a conserved density cannot form within a $\lambda$ linear in the distance (also for the highest eigenvector); stronger sources are out of scope; control: oscillator cells with $A=B=q_x$, where $f_A=1$.

Oscillator class, $M\to\infty$ then $L\to\infty$, $A=B=q_x$: exact $\delta a_{\mathbf k}(\lambda)=-(1-\cos\Omega_{\mathbf k}\lambda)/\Omega_{\mathbf k}^2$, $\Omega_{\mathbf k}=\hat K(\mathbf k)^{1/2}$, and $u=\delta a-\delta a_{\rm st}=\int e^{i\mathbf k\cdot x}\cos(\Omega_{\mathbf k}\lambda)\Omega_{\mathbf k}^{-2}\,d^Dk/(2\pi)^D$.

Formation criterion along an axis: $|\Delta_D(\rho,\lambda)|\le\varepsilon$ for every $\lambda\ge\lambda_f$, with $\Delta_3$ the value ratio minus 1 ($D=3$) and $\Delta_1$ the difference ratio minus 1 ($D=1$); $\lambda_{\rm form}(\rho;\varepsilon)$ and the arrival $\lambda_{\rm arr}(\rho;\eta)$.

Scaling limit $\rho\to\infty$ at fixed $w=c_0\lambda/\rho$, $\mu=m_h\rho/c_0$, $D=1$ and $D=3$: $\Delta_\infty=-1$ for $w<1$ and $\Delta_\infty=e^\mu-1-\mu e^\mu I_\mu(\mu\sqrt{w^2-1})$ for $w>1$, $I_\mu(Y)=\int_0^YJ_1(y)(y^2+\mu^2)^{-1/2}dy$.

Item 3, oscillator class on the ring ($D=1$) and the cubic torus ($D=3$), order $g_s\to0$, $M\to\infty$, $L\to\infty$, $\rho\to\infty$, then $\mu$ small, for every $K$ with a finite caustic set under the stationary-phase estimates of Step 6(b) (shown for the nearest-neighbour contract, caustic values the front and $w\approx2.41$, $3.15$, and for the control (4.16); assumed for the other members): for every $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$ with $\mu e^\mu(1+\mu/2)<\varepsilon$, $c_0\lambda_{\rm form}(\rho;\varepsilon)/\rho\to1$: formation within a $\lambda$ linear in the distance at the speed $c_0$; lattice correction $O(\rho^{1/3})$ once the caustic wakes ($O(\rho^{-1/3})$ in $D=3$) are below $\varepsilon-\mu e^\mu(1+\mu/2)$.

$c_0\le v_{\rm front}\le v_{\rm slope}$ for every $K$ of the class; under the conditions of (4.14) (finite caustic set, stationary-phase estimates), $v_{\rm form}=c_0$ and the first change arrives with $v_{\rm front}$; for the nearest-neighbour contract all three equal $\sqrt{\kappa_h}$.
Control of item 3: $\hat K_0=\sum_i(1-\cos k_i)(8-6\cos k_i)$ is in the class with $c_0=1<v_{\rm front}=v_{\rm slope}=2.475$.
Item 4, ring (or a lattice axis of the tori by assumption): $v_{\rm form}/v_{\max}=c_0/(k\tau)$; the two speeds are equal if and only if $c_0=k\tau$.

$\varepsilon=0.1$: control (4.16) $c_0\lambda_{\rm form}/\rho\to1$ (1.018 at $\rho=512$, $D=1$; 1.082 at $\rho=48$, $D=3$), arrival at $\rho/v_{\rm front}$; nearest neighbour 1.13 at $\rho=512$ ($D=1$), 3.1 to 3.9 in $D=3$ at $\rho\le48$ (caustic wakes $\propto\rho^{-1/3}$); field of 06-ilang-source $4\zeta\lambda_{\rm form}/\rho^2\to1$.

open_issues: Item 2, position form: derived for formation on a whole shell (4.8); for a single place only for the field of 06-ilang-source ((8.14) and the code).

Item 3: the remainder estimates of Step 6(b) are stationary-phase estimates; the caustic condition is shown here only for the nearest-neighbour contract and (4.16), and is an assumption of (4.14) for the other members of the class.
Item 3: the approach to v_form = c_0 is slow when the front coincides with c_0 (nearest neighbour); at ρ ≤ 48 in D = 3, λ_form is still 3 to 4 times ρ/c_0.
Item 1 for eigenvectors inside the spectrum: (4.4) holds with the sum of |ω_n| times the weights in place of f_A, but (4.5) does not apply.
Item 4 on the tori rests on the assumption that the coupling map runs along a lattice axis.
